_about: Every deny/ask rule in .claude/settings.json, with the rule it enforces and a probe command. Checked by scripts/permissions-smoke.mjs — a rule without an entry, or an entry without its rule, fails CI. Deny rules match the command text an agent normally writes; they are not a sandbox (see the script header).
